snippet.title: Mega Drive Longplay [059] Undead Line
snippet.description:
http://www.longplays.org

Played by: Mad-Matt

Released only in Japanese region. This longplay has been played on 'Crazy' Difficulty and well, it is exactly that!  I Have tried to show all weapons powered to maximum although I always seem to choose the wrong weapon for the boss fights ahead. I'm not really sure what all the rpg style level upgrading is all about as it doesnt have a huge effect durring gameplay apart from agility and powerup level that I noticed.

Collecting the fairies normal grants some random powerup but I dont think they were awarding me anything on this difficulty level.

The game has been fan translated to english by by M.I.J.E.T. -
